[ASSISTANT_SAID] Planning meals in advance can save time, money, and stress.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested 7 healthy lunch ideas for the week:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Monday: Turkey and Avocado Wrap** - Whole wheat tortilla, sliced turkey breast, avocado, lettuce, tomato, and mustard; Cost: ~ $2.50 per serving; Energy-boosting benefits: Whole grain tortilla, protein-rich turkey, healthy fats from avocado.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Tuesday: Quinoa Salad Jar** - Cooked quinoa, canned black beans, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, balsamic vinaigrette; Cost: ~ $3.25 per serving; Energy-boosting benefits: Complex carbs from quinoa, protein-rich black beans, hydrating veggies.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Wednesday: Grilled Chicken and Veggie Sandwich** - Whole wheat bread, grilled chicken breast, roasted veggies, hummus; Cost: ~ $3.50 per serving; Energy-boosting benefits: Lean protein from chicken, complex carbs from whole wheat bread, fiber-rich veggies.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Thursday: Lentil Soup with Whole Grain Bread** - Cooked lentils, diced veggies, whole grain bread; Cost: ~ $2.75 per serving; Energy-boosting benefits: Plant-based protein from lentils, complex carbs from whole grain bread, fiber-rich veggies.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Friday: Energy-Boosting Salad** - Mixed greens, grilled chicken breast, sliced almonds, dried cranberries, citrus vinaigrette; Cost: ~ $3.75 per serving; Energy-boosting benefits: Lean protein from chicken, complex carbs from almonds, natural sugars from cranberries.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Saturday: Tuna Salad Sandwich** - Canned tuna, low-fat mayo, chopped onions, diced celery, whole wheat bread; Cost: ~ $3.25 per serving; Energy-boosting benefits: Protein-rich tuna, complex carbs from whole wheat bread, healthy fats from mayo.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Sunday: Roasted Veggie and Goat Cheese Wrap** - Whole wheat tortilla, roasted veggies, crumbled goat cheese, mixed greens; Cost: ~ $3.50 per serving; Energy-boosting benefits: Complex carbs from whole wheat tortilla, protein-rich goat cheese, fiber-rich veggies.
